answers.how: The maximum horizontal extent is about 205 px. Tracking the flight gives approximately 96 px/s², so the prior sets a scale of 48 px/m; 205/48 ≈ 4.3.
The maximum vertical extent is about 153 px. Using the acceleration-derived scale of 48 px/m gives 153/48 ≈ 3.2.
Fitting the flight trajectory while smoothing out flapping gives about 48 px/s at 0.5 s. Dividing by 48 px/m gives 1 m/s.
The smoothed flight trajectory gives about 96 px/s at 1.0 s. Dividing by the acceleration-derived scale of 48 px/m gives 2 m/s.
